description: Browse or filter the published place cards in a named GoVisit destination collection. Use it to pick entries that fit the traveler's needs and open their profiles. The results reflect the collection's published selection.

accessibility.description: Optional published accessibility label or code.

audience.description: Optional published audience label or code.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

name.description: Optional published place name or partial name.

pagePath.description: Canonical GoVisit page path supplying this tool's published context; no origin, query or fragment.

name: list_collection_places
title: List collection places
